checks: explicit PostgreSQL schema migration is repeatable
queued job and durable state survive actual PostgreSQL restart
worker consumes persisted job and returns actual result
failed job retries with backoff and completes
delayed job is not consumed before its delay
duplicate job ID does not execute again
exhausted attempts retain failed state and reason
QueueEvents reports real completion and progress
scope: Real isolated Windows PostgreSQL and queue/counter/resource-contract proof; application adapters/provider/UI/native clean-machine acceptance not tested
